title: SRE correction tool items file
description: One entry per row the tool will touch. The expected_* guards make a wrong company_id fail loudly instead of silently corrupting real stock, because company ids are per-environment auto-increment.

company_id.description: Target company id, resolved in THIS environment. null only in the generic template.

expected_name.description: Company name the id must resolve to. The tool aborts on mismatch.

expected_ship_to_code.description: Ship-to code the id must resolve to. The tool aborts on mismatch.
